**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

Dear Miss Yonge	
[I](../persons.html#939) enclose a list of the presentation [copies](../books.html#53) we have sent out.

Including those to the Press. I dont know whether there are any other papers that you have been in the habit of having your books sent to. I will send any you suggest gladly.
I am sorry that your parcel went by a route that is inconvenient to you.

We will remember again when we have any thing to send.

We will advertise the [Book of Golden Deeds](../books.html#51) at once.

When you come to London I have a larger scheme to speak to you about if you are at all free to enter into it.
I am asking [Mrs Macmillan](../persons.html#941) to try to arrange a meeting, she will communicate with you.

My printer will not give me the exact account for the Stereotypes
[The rest of this letter is illegible.]
